text: Reserve the worst-case scene, selection and pointer textures together: three RGBA layers at four bytes per device texel, including raster rounding. Refuse a surface above 128 MiB before compilation/allocation, with logical size, device scale, required bytes and budget as typed error operands. Retain the 8192-edge guard independently. 128 MiB reserves headroom for other views and temporary/clip storage within the usual 512 MiB Prism pool; it is a per-host admission cap rather than a replacement for the global allocator. Reserve empty overlays too so later selection cannot invalidate the admitted surface. Boundary regressions cover 4096x2730 vs 4096x2731, equivalent HiDPI surfaces and the 805306368-byte 8192-square refusal. The renderer releases old textures on a refused surface and recovers at a valid size.
